It describes the statistical methods used, including Shrout and Bolger's (2002) bootstrap procedures with 1000 samples in Mplus, to estimate indirect effects and confidence intervals. The results indicate that body appreciation fully mediated the link from discrepancy perfectionism to intuitive eating and partially mediated the links from attachment anxiety and restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages to intuitive eating, while the indirect effect from order perfectionism was not significant.
